+++ b/h11/tests/test_receive_body_limit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+import pytest
+
+from h11 import CLIENT, SERVER, ERROR, NEED_DATA, Connection, Data, EndOfMessage, RemoteProtocolError, Request, Response
+
+
+def opened(mode, limit):
+    c = Connection(CLIENT if mode == "eof" else SERVER, max_receive_body_size=limit)
+    if mode == "eof":
+        c.send(Request(method="GET", target="/", headers=[("Host", "example")]))
+        c.send(EndOfMessage())
+        head = b"HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\n\r\n"
+    elif mode == "length":
+        head = b"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example\r\nContent-Length: 3\r\n\r\n"
+    else:
+        head = b"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"
+    c.receive_data(head)
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), (Request, Response))
+    return c
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["length", "chunked", "eof"])
+def test_limit_is_cumulative_and_attributed_to_peer(mode):
+    c = opened(mode, 2)
+    c.receive_data(b"2\r\nab\r\n" if mode == "chunked" else b"ab")
+    assert c.next_event().data == b"ab"
+    assert c.next_event() is NEED_DATA
+    c.receive_data(b"1\r\nc\r\n0\r\n\r\n" if mode == "chunked" else b"c")
+    with pytest.raises(RemoteProtocolError) as caught:
+        c.next_event()
+    assert caught.value.error_status_hint == 413
+    assert c.their_state is ERROR
+    with pytest.raises(RemoteProtocolError):
+        c.next_event()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["length", "chunked", "eof"])
+def test_exact_limit_excludes_framing_headers_and_trailers(mode):
+    c = opened(mode, 3)
+    if mode == "chunked":
+        wire = b"3\r\nabc\r\n0\r\nX-Trailer: longer-than-the-body\r\n\r\n"
+    else:
+        wire = b"abc"
+    c.receive_data(wire)
+    assert c.next_event().data == b"abc"
+    if mode == "eof":
+        c.receive_data(b"")
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), EndOfMessage)
+
+
+def test_zero_limit_allows_bodyless_request():
+    c = Connection(SERVER, max_receive_body_size=0)
+    c.receive_data(b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example\r\n\r\n")
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), Request)
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), EndOfMessage)
+
+
+def test_count_resets_for_next_cycle_and_does_not_count_sent_body():
+    c = Connection(SERVER, max_receive_body_size=2)
+    for _ in range(2):
+        c.receive_data(b"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nab")
+        assert isinstance(c.next_event(), Request)
+        assert c.next_event().data == b"ab"
+        assert isinstance(c.next_event(), EndOfMessage)
+        c.send(Response(status_code=200, headers=[("Content-Length", "4")]))
+        c.send(Data(data=b"wxyz"))
+        c.send(EndOfMessage())
+        c.start_next_cycle()
+
+
+def test_none_remains_unlimited():
+    c = opened("length", None)
+    c.receive_data(b"abc")
+    assert c.next_event().data == b"abc"
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), EndOfMessage)
+
+
+def test_rejects_entire_over_limit_event_not_a_shortened_fragment():
+    c = opened("length", 2)
+    c.receive_data(b"abc")
+    with pytest.raises(RemoteProtocolError) as caught:
+        c.next_event()
+    assert caught.value.error_status_hint == 413
+    assert c.their_state is ERROR

spec.question: Add an optional `max_receive_body_size` keyword argument to `Connection`, defaulting to `None` for the existing unlimited behavior. For a nonnegative integer limit, cap the cumulative payload bytes received in the current request/response cycle, across all incoming Data events and all three body-framing modes. Do not count start lines, headers, chunk syntax, trailers, or outgoing data. Enforce the cap when `next_event()` would return Data: if that entire event would take the total above the limit, raise `RemoteProtocolError` with `error_status_hint=413` instead of returning or shortening it, and put the peer role into ERROR through the normal error handling. Do not reject a message merely because its declared Content-Length exceeds the cap. Exactly the limit is allowed, including normal EndOfMessage processing; a zero limit permits bodyless messages. Reset the received-body total only when `start_next_cycle()` succeeds. Preserve existing behavior when the option is omitted or is `None`. Return a unified diff against non-test repository files.
